License and Commercialization Agreements with Bioprojet
paragraphs: We are cultivating a differentiated neuroscience company, rooted in innovation and driven by a commitment to addressing the unmet needs of patients living with neurological diseases. To date, we have focused on rare neurological diseases with a growing portfolio now spanning sleep/wake, rare epilepsy, and neurobehavioral and we are harnessing scientific insights and pioneering approaches to advance meaningful treatments that help patients thrive.

In July 2017, we entered into a License Agreement (as amended, the "2017 LCA") with Bioprojet Société Civile de Recherche ("Bioprojet") whereby we acquired the exclusive right to commercialize the pharmaceutical compound pitolisant. Our lead product, WAKIX® (pitolisant) ("WAKIX"), is a first-in-class therapy with a novel mechanism of action designed to enhance histamine signaling in the brain by binding to H3 receptors. Since its initial FDA approval in 2019 for excessive daytime sleepiness ("EDS") in adult patients with narcolepsy and subsequent approvals for cataplexy in adult patients in 2020, EDS in pediatric patients six years and older in 2024 and cataplexy in pediatric patients six years and older in 2026, WAKIX has continued to reshape the treatment landscape for narcolepsy and remains the only FDA-approved treatment for narcolepsy that is not scheduled as a controlled substance by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration ("DEA").

Beyond narcolepsy, we have taken a mechanistic-based approach to expanding the reach of pitolisant, advancing late-stage clinical programs exploring pitolisant in idiopathic hypersomnia ("IH"), Prader-Willi syndrome ("PWS") and myotonic dystrophy type 1 ("DM1") and continue to grow our impact in other rare neurological diseases. In July 2022, we entered into a License and Commercialization Agreement with Bioprojet (the "2022 LCA") whereby we obtained exclusive rights to manufacture, develop and commercialize one or more next generation pitolisant based products in the United States and Latin America. Two of the next generation formulations, pitolisant Gastro-Resistant ("Pitolisant GR") and pitolisant High-Dose ("Pitolisant HD") are currently in clinical development.

In April 2024, we expanded into orexin science through a sublicense agreement with Bioprojet for an orexin 2 receptor agonist ("BP1.15205") in preclinical development for narcolepsy and other potential indications (the "Sublicense"). Under the Sublicense, we obtained the exclusive right to develop, manufacture and commercialize BP1.15205 in the United States and Latin American territories, which are rights originally licensed from Teijin Pharma, the innovator of BP1.15205. We further broadened our portfolio into rare epilepsy with the acquisition of Epygenix Therapeutics, Inc., adding global rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize EPX-100, a serotonin (5HT-2) receptor agonist, and EPX-200, a selective 5HT-2C agonist. EPX-100 is in two Phase 3 registrational trials, one each for Dravet Syndrome ("DS") and Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome ("LGS"), and EPX-200 is in the pre-IND phase for developmental and epileptic encephalopathies ("DEEs").

In June 2025, we entered into a research collaboration, option and license agreement (the "CiRC Agreement") with a related party, CiRC Biosciences, Inc. ("CiRC"). Under this agreement, Harmony and CiRC will collaborate on the research and development of two discovery-stage candidates, CBS105 for treatment-resistant narcolepsy and CBS104 for refractory epilepsy (together the "Candidates"), using cell replacement therapy for the treatment of refractory epilepsies and treatment-resistant narcolepsy.

Our innovative portfolio of assets reflects our dedication to novel science, innovative therapies and excellence in delivering these treatments to patients with serious medical conditions who have few or no available options.
Our operations are conducted by our wholly owned subsidiaries, Harmony Biosciences, LLC and Harmony Biosciences Management, Inc.

WAKIX (pitolisant). Pitolisant was developed by Bioprojet and approved by the European Medicines Agency (the "EMA") in 2016 for the treatment of narcolepsy in adult patients with or without cataplexy and in 2021 for the treatment of EDS in adult patients with obstructive sleep apnea. We acquired an exclusive license to develop, manufacture and commercialize pitolisant in the United States pursuant to the 2017 LCA. Pitolisant was granted Orphan Drug designation for the treatment of narcolepsy by the FDA in 2010. It received Breakthrough Therapy designation for the treatment of cataplexy in patients with narcolepsy and Fast Track designation for the treatment of EDS and cataplexy in patients with narcolepsy in April 2018. In August 2019, WAKIX was approved by the FDA for the treatment of EDS in adult patients with narcolepsy, and its U.S. commercial launch was initiated in November 2019. In October 2020, WAKIX was approved by the FDA for the treatment of cataplexy in adult patients with narcolepsy. WAKIX was approved by the FDA for treatment of EDS and cataplexy in patients six years and older in 2024 and 2026, respectively.
WAKIX represents a novel approach to narcolepsy treatment. We believe that WAKIX offers a meaningfully differentiated product profile over current treatment options for the following reasons:

● First-in-class molecule with a novel MOA. WAKIX is a first-in-class molecule with a novel mechanism of action ("MOA") and is the only selective H3 receptor antagonist/inverse agonist approved by the FDA. Pitolisant is thought to work by regulating histamine, such that it activates wake-promoting neurons and inhibits sleep promoting neurons, which helps to stabilize states of sleep and wakefulness. We believe that these novel characteristics differentiate it from other narcolepsy treatments.

● First-and-only non-scheduled treatment for narcolepsy. WAKIX is the first-and-only FDA-approved treatment for narcolepsy that is not scheduled as a controlled substance by the DEA. We believe one of the most significant unmet needs is the availability of non-scheduled treatment options.

● WAKIX is not a stimulant. Stimulants are one of the most commonly prescribed treatments for patients with narcolepsy and have the potential for abuse so their use must be considered carefully by health care providers ("HCPs") and patients. Unlike stimulants, in clinical trials, WAKIX showed no evidence for the development of drug tolerance or withdrawal symptoms. In addition, unlike stimulants, WAKIX does not increase dopamine levels in the brain's reward center, which contributes to its lack of abuse potential.

● WAKIX can be used as monotherapy or administered concomitantly with other narcolepsy treatments. Narcolepsy is a difficult disorder to manage, and the majority of narcolepsy patients often require multiple medications to treat their symptoms. WAKIX was studied in combination with each of modafinil and sodium oxybate (two common treatments for narcolepsy) and demonstrated no effect on the pharmacokinetic ("PK") profile of either treatment, and neither treatment had a clinically relevant effect on the PK profile of WAKIX. We believe the ability of WAKIX to be taken as monotherapy or concomitantly with other narcolepsy medications affords HCPs the flexibility to better manage their patients with narcolepsy.

● WAKIX is a once-daily oral tablet administered in the morning upon wakening. Patients have identified a need for treatment options that are easier to take and are dosed less frequently. We believe that once-daily dosing with WAKIX addresses this need and may help improve patient compliance with treatment.

At Harmony, we are cultivating a differentiated neuroscience company, rooted in innovation and driven by a commitment to addressing the unmet needs of patients living with neurological diseases. To date, we have focused on rare neurological diseases with a growing portfolio now spanning sleep/wake, neurobehavioral, and rare epilepsy, and we are harnessing scientific insights and pioneering approaches to advance meaningful treatments that help patients thrive. Our operations are conducted by our wholly owned subsidiaries, Harmony Biosciences, LLC and Harmony Biosciences Management, Inc.

Pitolisant was developed by Bioprojet and approved by the EMA in 2016 for the treatment of narcolepsy in adult patients with or without cataplexy and in 2021 for the treatment of EDS in adult patients with obstructive sleep apnea. We acquired an exclusive license to develop, manufacture and commercialize pitolisant in the United States pursuant to our license agreement with Bioprojet (as amended, the "2017 LCA") in July 2017. Pitolisant was granted Orphan Drug designation for the treatment of narcolepsy by the FDA in 2010. It received Breakthrough Therapy designation for the treatment of cataplexy in patients with narcolepsy and Fast Track designation for the treatment of EDS and cataplexy in patients with narcolepsy in April 2018. In August 2019, WAKIX was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") for the treatment of EDS in adult patients with narcolepsy, and its U.S. commercial launch was initiated in November 2019. In October 2020, WAKIX was approved by the FDA for the treatment of cataplexy in adult patients with narcolepsy.

We believe that pitolisant's ability to regulate histamine mediated through histamine-3 receptor antagonist and inverse agonist activity gives it the potential to provide therapeutic benefit in other rare neurological diseases.

We are focusing our development efforts on other rare neurological disorders in which EDS is a prominent symptom, including Prader-Willi Syndrome ("PWS") and myotonic dystrophy type 1, otherwise known as dystrophia myotonica ("DM1"). Based on the positive signals from the data from our Phase 2 proof-of-concept signal detection clinical trial to evaluate pitolisant for the treatment of EDS and other key behavioral symptoms in patients with PWS, an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA was held in June 2023. We aligned with the FDA on the proposed Phase 3 registration study design to support further investigation of pitolisant as a potential treatment to address the unmet medical need for children, adolescents and adults with PWS experiencing EDS, for which there is currently no approved treatment. In October 2023, we received FDA alignment regarding the study design for the Phase 3 TEMPO study in patients with PWS, which has the potential to serve as the registrational trial and support our efforts to seek pediatric exclusivity for pitolisant. In February 2024, the FDA granted Orphan Drug designation to pitolisant for the treatment of PWS. The Phase 3 registrational trial, the TEMPO study, was initiated in the first quarter of 2024. In June 2021, we initiated a Phase 2 proof-of-concept signal detection clinical trial to evaluate pitolisant for the treatment of EDS, fatigue and cognitive dysfunction in adult patients with DM1 and announced topline results from this trial in the fourth quarter of 2023, in which clinically meaningful improvements were demonstrated in EDS and fatigue, the two most prominent non-muscular symptoms in patients with DM1. The safety and tolerability profile of pitolisant in adult patients with DM1 was consistent with the established safety profile of pitolisant with no new safety signals detected and no serious adverse events reported.

Our partner, Bioprojet completed a Phase 3 trial in pediatric patients with narcolepsy and submitted the trial data to the European Medicines Agency (the "EMA") seeking approval for a pediatric narcolepsy indication. In January 2023,

Bioprojet received a positive opinion from the EMA's Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use ("CHMP") and in March 2023, the EMA granted approval for the marketing authorization of WAKIX for the treatment of narcolepsy with or without cataplexy in children six and older. Based on the data from the positive Phase 3 trial conducted by Bioprojet, we submitted an sNDA for pediatric narcolepsy in December 2023. In June 2024, we announced that the FDA approved our sNDA for WAKIX for the treatment of EDS in pediatric patients six years of age and older with narcolepsy. In addition, in June 2024, the FDA did not approve our sNDA seeking to expand the WAKIX label for the treatment of pediatric patients with cataplexy. In October 2024, we held a Type A meeting with the FDA to discuss the pediatric cataplexy indication and reached alignment on a path to sNDA resubmission, which was submitted in the third quarter of 2025. In February 2026, the FDA approved WAKIX for the treatment of cataplexy in pediatric patients six years and older with narcolepsy.

We remain committed to obtaining pediatric exclusivity for WAKIX. We believe the initiation of the PWS Phase 3 registrational trial, the TEMPO study, and our current data in pediatric narcolepsy, which resulted in the FDA's approval of WAKIX in its current pediatric indication, are supportive of our efforts in obtaining pediatric exclusivity for WAKIX.

We have expanded our pipeline through the acquisition of additional assets that focus on addressing the unmet needs of patients living with rare neurological diseases as well as patients living with other neurological diseases who have unmet medical needs. We are targeting assets that will allow us to further leverage the expertise and infrastructure that we have successfully built at Harmony so we can optimize the benefit of internal synergies. Consistent with this objective, in July 2022, we entered into a License and Commercialization Agreement (the "2022 LCA") with Bioprojet whereby we obtained exclusive rights to manufacture, develop and commercialize one or more new products based on pitolisant in the United States and Latin America, with the potential to add additional indications and formulations upon the agreement of both parties. We have made progress in the development of two new formulations of pitolisant: pitolisant GR and pitolisant HD. Both formulations entered clinical studies in the fourth quarter of 2023. We received data from the pitolisant GR pilot bioequivalence study, which supports further development of Pitolisant GR. In addition, we completed a dosing optimization study that supports initiating Pitolisant GR at the therapeutic dose of 17.8mg without titration. We initiated the pivotal bioequivalence study in the first quarter of 2025 and announced positive topline data readout in the fourth quarter of 2025. We anticipate a PDUFA date for Pitolisant GR in the first quarter of 2027. We received data from the pitolisant HD pilot pharmacokinetics study in June 2024, which also supports advancing this development program toward pivotal trials. We submitted an IND application for pitolisant HD with the FDA to initiate Phase 3 registrational trials in narcolepsy and IH in the fourth quarter of 2025. After receiving "Study May Proceed" letters from the FDA, the Phase 3 registrational study in narcolepsy, ONSTRIDE1, and the Phase 3 registrational study in IH, ONSTRIDE2, were initiated. We anticipate topline data from both studies in 2027 and a potential PDUFA date in 2028. Utility patents have been filed for both of these formulations, with the potential for patent protection to the mid-2040's.

In April 2024, we entered into a sublicense agreement with Bioprojet for an orexin-2 receptor agonist (OX2R) ("BP1.15205") to be evaluated for the treatment of narcolepsy and other potential indications (the "Sublicense"). Under the Sublicense, we have obtained the exclusive right to develop, manufacture and commercialize BP1.15205 in the United States and Latin American territories, which are rights that Bioprojet originally licensed from Teijin Pharma, the innovator of BP1.15205. In June 2025, we announced positive pre-clinical data demonstrating significant wake-promoting and cataplexy-suppressing effects in a standard transgenic mouse model of narcolepsy type 1and presented safety data from the three-month GLP toxicity studies in two different species. We filed an investigational medicinal product dossier ("IMPD") with the EMA and began first-in-human studies in the fourth quarter of 2025 with topline data anticipated in 2026.

In June 2025, we entered into a research collaboration, option and license agreement (the "CiRC Agreement") with a related party, CiRC Biosciences, Inc. ("CiRC"). Under this agreement, Harmony and CiRC will collaborate on the research and development of two discovery-stage candidates, CBS105 for treatment-resistant narcolepsy and CBS104 for refractory epilepsy (together the "Candidates"), using cell replacement therapy for the treatment of refractory epilepsies and treatment-resistant narcolepsy.

In August 2021, we acquired HBS-102, a Melanin-concentrating hormone receptor type 1 (MCHR1) antagonist previously developed as CSTI-100/ALB-127258(a)/ALB-127258 (the "Compound"), along with intellectual property and other assets related to the development, manufacture, and commercialization of the Compound from ConSynance Therapeutics, Inc. We acquired full development and commercialization rights for HBS-102 globally, but we have provided an indication-limited grant-back license to ConSynance for the development and commercialization of the Compound in Greater China. We conducted a preclinical PoC study to assess the effect of HBS-102 on hyperphagia, weight gain and other metabolic parameters in a mouse model of PWS. The final report was received during the third quarter of 2024 and
the results are consistent with the expected results. In addition, a 13-week toxicology study has been completed, and we believe the preliminary results are encouraging.

We are exploring an opportunity to evaluate a new formulation of pitolisant for the treatment of fatigue in larger CNS indications. The histaminergic mechanism of action is uniquely positioned to address all three different dimensions of fatigue – physical, emotional and cognition. We have generated clinical data to support the utility of pitolisant to treat fatigue in the phase 2 proof-of-concept study in DM1 and in a phase 3 study for the treatment of residual sleepiness in patients with obstructive sleep apnea. We plan to evaluate this new formulation for fatigue in broader indications, with fatigue in MS as the lead indication, and to explore other potential opportunities such as fatigue in stroke and Parkinson's disease. Our current efforts are focused on formulation optimization with new modes of delivery and towards a Phase 1 PK study.

paragraphs: 我們正在培育一傢俱備差異化神經科學技術的公司，根植於創新，並以解決神經系統疾病患者未被滿足的醫療需求為動力。截至目前為止，我們專注於罕見神經系統疾病，目前的產品組合已擴展至睡眠/清醒、罕見癲癇以及神經行為領域，並透過科學見解與先進方法，推動具意義的治療方案，協助患者獲得更好的生活品質。

2017年7月，我們與Bioprojet Société Civile de Recherche（"Bioprojet"）簽訂了授權協議（經修正後，稱為"2017 LCA"），取得獨家商業化藥物化合物pitolisant的權利。我們的主力產品WAKIX®（pitolisant）（"WAKIX"）是一種首創療法，具有創新作用機制，設計用以增強大腦中的組胺訊號，透過與H3受體結合來實現。自2019年獲得美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）批准，用於治療成人納祿症（"EDS"）患者過度日間嗜睡，以及2020年獲得批准用於治療成人納祿症患者的猝睡（cataplexy），2024年獲得批准用於治療六歲以上兒童納祿症患者的EDS，以及2026年獲得批准用於治療六歲以上兒童納祿症患者的cataplexy以來，WAKIX持續重塑納祿症的治療版圖，並仍是美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）批准的唯一納祿症治療藥物，且未被美國藥物管制局（"DEA"）列為管制藥物。

除了納祿症，我們透過機制導向的方法，擴展pitolisant的應用範圍，推動晚期臨牀試驗，探索pitolisant在原發性過度睡眠（"IH"）、普拉德-威利症候羣（"PWS"）以及第一型肌強直症（"DM1"）的應用，並持續在其他罕見神經系統疾病領域擴大影響力。2022年7月，我們與Bioprojet簽訂了授權與商業化協議（"2022 LCA"），取得獨家權利，用以在美國與拉丁美洲開發、製造與商業化一種或多種下一代pitolisant基於的產品。其中兩種下一代製劑，pitolisant Gastro-Resistant（"Pitolisant GR"）與pitolisant High-Dose（"Pitolisant HD"）目前正進行臨牀開發。

2024年4月，我們透過與Bioprojet的 sublicense 協議，進入手 orexin 科學領域，取得 orexin 2 受體激動劑（"BP1.15205"）的專利，該藥物目前處於納祿症及其他潛在適應症的臨牀前開發階段（"Sublicense"）。根據此 sublicense，我們取得獨家權利，用以在美國與拉丁美洲地區開發、製造與商業化 BP1.15205，這些權利最初由 Teijin Pharma（BP1.15205 的創新者）授權。我們進一步將產品組合擴展至罕見癲癇，透過收購 Epygenix Therapeutics, Inc.，取得全球開發、製造與商業化 EPX-100（一種血清素（5HT-2）受體激動劑）與 EPX-200（一種選擇性 5HT-2C 激動劑）的權利。EPX-100 正進行兩項 III 期註冊臨牀試驗，分別針對 Dravet 綜合症（"DS"）與 Lennox-Gastaut 綜合症（"LGS"），而 EPX-200 正處於 pre-IND 階段，用於開發與癲癇性腦病（"DEEs"）的治療。
2025年6月，我們與關係企業 CiRC Biosciences, Inc.（"CiRC"）簽訂了研究合作、選擇權與授權協議（"CiRC 協議"）。根據此協議，Harmony 與 CiRC 將合作研究與開發兩種處於發現階段的候選藥物 CBS105 用於治療難治性納祿症，以及 CBS104 用於治療難治性癲癇（合稱 "Candidates"），利用細胞替代療法治療難治性癲癇與難治性納祿症。
我們創新性的資產組合反映了我們對新興科學、創新療法以及為患有嚴重醫療條件且缺乏或無可用治療選項的患者提供這些治療方案的承諾。
我們的業務由我們的 wholly owned subsidiaries，Harmony Biosciences, LLC 與 Harmony Biosciences Management, Inc. 進行。

WAKIX（pitolisant）。pitolisant 由 Bioprojet 開發，並於 2016 年獲得歐洲藥物管理局（"EMA"）批准，用於治療成人納祿症患者，包括有或無猝睡的情況，並於 2021 年獲得批准，用於治療患有阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症（"OSA"）的成人患者的 EDS。我們根據 2017 LCA 獲得獨家權利，用以在美國開發、製造與商業化 pitolisant。pitolisant 於 2010 年獲得美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）授予的罕見疾病藥物指定（Orphan Drug designation），用於治療納祿症。它於 2018 年 4 月獲得治療納祿症患者猝睡的突破性療法指定（Breakthrough Therapy designation），並於 2018 年 4 月獲得治療納祿症患者 EDS 和猝睡的快速通道指定（Fast Track designation）。2019 年 8 月，WAKIX 獲得 FDA 批准，用於治療納祿症成人患者的 EDS，並於 2019 年 11 月啟動美國市場的商業發行。2020 年 10 月，WAKIX 獲得 FDA 批准，用於治療納祿症成人患者的猝睡。WAKIX 於 2024 年獲得 FDA 批准，用於治療六歲以上兒童的 EDS 和 2026 年獲得批准用於治療六歲以上兒童的猝睡。
WAKIX 代表一種針對癲癇治療的新方法。我們認為 WAKIX 在以下原因下，與現有治療選項相比，具有顯著差異的產品特性：
● 首個上市的分子，具有新穎的機轉作用。WAKIX 是一個首個上市的分子，具有新穎的機轉作用（"MOA"），並為美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）唯一核准的選擇性 H3 受體拮抗劑/逆轉劑。Pitolisant 被認為透過調節組胺，使促醒神經元活化並抑制促睡神經元，有助於穩定睡眠與清醒狀態。我們認為這些新穎特性使其與其他癲癇治療藥物有所區別。
● 癲癇治療中首個且唯一非管制藥品。WAKIX 是首個且唯一被美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准的非管制藥品，用於癲癇治療。我們認為其中最迫切的未滿足需求之一，就是非管制藥品治療選項的可及性。
● WAKIX 不屬於興奮劑。興奮劑是目前治療癲癇患者最常處方的治療方式之一，且具有濫用潛力，因此必須由醫療人員（"HCPs"）與患者謹慎考量使用。與興奮劑不同，臨牀試驗中 WAKIX 顯示無發展藥物耐受性或戒斷症狀的證據。此外，與興奮劑不同，WAKIX 不會增加大腦獎勵中心的多巴胺水平，這有助於其缺乏濫用潛力。

● WAKIX 可單獨使用或與其他癲癇治療藥物同時使用。癲癇是一種難以管理的疾病，大多數癲癇患者通常需要多種藥物來治療其症狀。WAKIX 在與莫達非尼與鈉氧安定（兩種常見的癲癇治療藥物）同時使用時，顯示對兩種治療藥物的藥動學（"PK"）特性無影響，且兩種治療藥物對 WAKIX 的藥動學特性也無臨牀相關影響。我們認為 WAKIX 可單獨使用或與其他癲癇治療藥物同時使用，使醫療人員（"HCPs"）能更靈活地管理癲癇患者。
● WAKIX 是每日一次的口服片劑，於早晨清醒時服用。患者已表達對治療選項的需求，這些選項更容易服用且劑量頻率較低。我們認為 WAKIX 每日一次的劑型可滿足此需求，並可能有助於提高患者治療的順從性。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果之分析，並與本年度年報（Form 10-K）所附之合併財務報表及相關附註一併參考。本討論包含基於目前計畫、預期與信念之展望性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述所預期者有重大差異，原因包括但不限於「風險因素」部分及本年度年報（Form 10-K）其他部分所列之因素。有關2024年12月31日財年與2023年12月31日財年比較之討論，已於2024年12月31日財年年報（Form 10-K）之「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分報告，該年報於2025年2月25日提交至證券交易委員會（SEC）。

在Harmony，我們正在培育一傢俱備差異化之神經科學公司，根植於創新，並以解決神經系統疾病患者未被滿足之醫療需求為動力。截至目前為止，我們已聚焦於罕見神經系統疾病，目前產品組合已擴展至睡眠/清醒、神經行為及罕見癲癇，並透過科學見解與創新方法，進步具意義之治療方案，協助患者獲得更好的生活品質。我們之營運由我們之 wholly owned subsidiaries，Harmony Biosciences, LLC 與 Harmony Biosciences Management, Inc. 進行。

Pitolisant 由 Bioprojet 開發，並於2016年獲歐盟藥物管理局（EMA）核准，用於治療成人患者之癲癇睡眠障礙（narcolepsy），包括有或無癲癇症（cataplexy）之患者；於2021年獲核准用於治療成人患者之阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症（obstructive sleep apnea）之日間嗜睡（EDS）。我們於2017年7月根據與 Bioprojet 之授權協議（經修正後之「2017 LCA」）取得獨家開發、製造與商業化 Pitolisant 之權利。Pitolisant 於2010年獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准為治療癲癇睡眠障礙之罕見藥物（Orphan Drug designation）。於2018年4月，Pitolisant 獲得治療癲癇症（cataplexy）之癲癇睡眠障礙患者之突破性療法（Breakthrough Therapy）核准，並獲治療日間嗜睡（EDS）及癲癇症（cataplexy）之癲癇睡眠障礙患者之快速通道（Fast Track）核准。於2019年8月，WAKIX 獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准用於治療癲癇睡眠障礙成人患者之日間嗜睡（EDS），並於2019年11月啟動美國市場之商業發行。於2020年10月，WAKIX 獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准用於治療癲癇睡眠障礙成人患者之癲癇症（cataplexy）。
我們認為 Pitolisant 能透過抑制組織胺-3 受體拮抗劑及反轉激動劑之作用調節組織胺，使其在其他罕見神經系統疾病中具有潛在治療效益。

我們目前聚焦於其他罕見神經系統疾病，其中日間嗜睡（EDS）為顯著症狀，包括普拉德-威利症候羣（Prader-Willi Syndrome，簡稱 PWS）及第一型肌強直性 dystrophia myotonica（DM1）。根據我們於評估 Pitolisant 用於治療 PWS 患者之日間嗜睡（EDS）及其他關鍵行為症狀之第二期臨牀試驗中所顯示之正面訊號，我們於2023年6月與 FDA 進行第二期結束會議（End-of-Phase 2 meeting）。我們與 FDA 達成共識，提出第三期登記研究設計，以支持進一步研究 Pitolisant 作為治療 PWS 患者之潛在治療方案，以解決目前尚無核准治療之未滿足醫療需求，包括兒童、青少年及成人患者之日間嗜睡（EDS）。於2023年10月，我們獲得 FDA 關於 PWS 第三期 TEMPO 研究設計之核准，此研究有潛力作為登記試驗，並支持我們尋求 Pitolisant 之兒童專用藥物獨佔權（pediatric exclusivity）。於2024年2月，FDA 授予 Pitolisant 療療 PWS 之罕見藥物核准（Orphan Drug designation）。第三期登記試驗 TEMPO 研究於2024年第一季啟動。於2021年6月，我們啟動一項第二期臨牀試驗，評估 Pitolisant 用於治療 DM1 成人患者之日間嗜睡（EDS）、疲勞及認知功能障礙，並於2023年第四季公佈此試驗之初步結果，顯示在 DM1 患者中，日間嗜睡（EDS）及疲勞兩項最顯著的非肌肉症狀有臨牀意義之改善。Pitolisant 在 DM1 成人患者中之安全性與耐受性與 Pitolisant 之既定安全性資料一致，未發現新之安全性訊號，亦未報告嚴重不良事件。
我們之合作夥伴 Bioprojet 完成一項兒童癲癇睡眠障礙患者之第三期試驗，並提交試驗資料至歐洲藥物管理局（EMA），以尋求核准兒童癲癇睡眠障礙之適應症。於2023年1月，

Bioprojet 獲得 EMA 藥物評估委員會（CHMP）之正面意見，並於2023年3月，EMA 核准 WAKIX 用於治療六歲以上之癲癇睡眠障礙（包括有或無癲癇症）之市場核准。根據 Bioprojet 所進行之正面第三期試驗資料，我們於2023年12月提交一項 sNDA（ supplemental New Drug Application）以核准兒童癲癇睡眠障礙。於2024年6月，我們宣佈 FDA 核准我們之 sNDA 用於 WAKIX 治療六歲以上之癲癇睡眠障礙兒童之日間嗜睡（EDS）。此外，於2024年6月，FDA 未核准我們之 sNDA 以擴展 WAKIX 標籤用於治療癲癇症（cataplexy）之兒童。於2024年10月，我們與 FDA 進行 Type A 會議討論兒童癲癇症（cataplexy）適應症，並達成共識於2025年第三季重新提交 sNDA。於2026年2月，FDA 核准 WAKIX 用於治療六歲以上之癲癇睡眠障礙兒童之癲癇症（cataplexy）。
我們持續致力於取得 WAKIX 之兒童專用藥物獨佔權（pediatric exclusivity）。我們認為 PWS 第三期登記試驗 TEMPO 研究之啟動，以及目前兒童癲癇睡眠障礙之資料，導致 FDA 核准 WAKIX 之現有兒童適應症，皆支持我們取得 WAKIX 之兒童專用藥物獨佔權（pediatric exclusivity）之努力。

我們透過取得額外資產來擴充產品線，這些資產專注於解決罕見神經系統疾病患者以及患有其他神經系統疾病且有未滿足醫療需求患者的未滿足需求。我們目標是取得資產，以進一步運用我們在Harmony成功建立的專業知識與基礎設施，從而優化內部協同效益。根據此目標，我們於2022年7月與Bioprojet簽訂了授權與商業化協議（"2022 LCA"），取得在美國與拉丁美洲製造、開發與商業化基於pitolisant之一或多種新產品的獨家權利，未來雙方同意後，亦有機會增加其他適應症與劑型。我們在兩種新劑型pitolisant的開發上取得進展：pitolisant GR與pitolisant HD。兩種劑型於2023年第四季進入臨牀研究。我們收到pitolisant GR試驗性生物等效性研究的數據，支持進一步開發Pitolisant GR。此外，我們完成劑量最佳化研究，支持以17.8mg的治療劑量開始使用Pitolisant GR，無需逐步增加劑量。我們於2025年第一季啟動關鍵性生物等效性研究，並於2025年第四季宣佈正面的初步數據。我們預期Pitolisant GR的PDUFA日期為2027年第一季。我們於2024年6月收到pitolisant HD試驗性藥動學研究的數據，也支持此開發計畫朝向關鍵性試驗推進。我們於2025年第四季向FDA提交IND申請，以啟動narcolepsy與IH的第三期註冊臨牀試驗。在收到FDA的"Study May Proceed"信函後，narcolepsy的第三期註冊臨牀試驗ONSTRIDE1與IH的第三期註冊臨牀試驗ONSTRIDE2已啟動。我們預期兩項試驗於2027年取得初步數據，並於2028年有潛在的PDUFA日期。為這兩種劑型已申請實用專利，預期專利保護至2040年代中期。

我們於2024年4月與Bioprojet簽訂 sublicense 協議，取得 orexin-2 受體激動劑（OX2R）（"BP1.15205"）的獨家開發、製造與商業化權利，用於評估治療narcolepsy及其他潛在適應症（"Sublicense"）。根據此 sublicense，我們取得在美國與拉丁美洲地區開發、製造與商業化BP1.15205的獨家權利，這些權利Bioprojet原為從Teijin Pharma取得，Teijin Pharma為BP1.15205的創新藥廠。我們於2025年6月宣佈正面的預臨牀數據，顯示在標準的narcolepsy type 1轉基因小鼠模型中，BP1.15205有顯著的清醒促進與猝倒抑制效果，並展示在兩種不同物種中進行的三月GLP毒性研究的安全數據。我們已向EMA提交 Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier（"IMPD"），並於2025年第四季開始首次人體研究，預期於2026年取得初步數據。
我們於2025年6月與相關當事人CiRC Biosciences, Inc.（"CiRC"）簽訂研究合作、選擇權與授權協議（"CiRC 協議"）。根據此協議，Harmony與CiRC將合作研究與開發兩種處於發現階段的候選藥物CBS105用於治療難治性narcolepsy與CBS104用於治療難治性癲癇（合稱"候選藥物"），運用細胞替代療法治療難治性癲癇與難治性narcolepsy。

我們於2021年8月取得HBS-102，一種Melanin-concentrating hormone receptor type 1（MCHR1）拮抗劑，先前開發為CSTI-100/ALB-127258(a)/ALB-127258（"化合物"），並取得與開發、製造與商業化該化合物相關的智慧財產權及其他資產，來自ConSynance Therapeutics, Inc. 我們取得HBS-102在全球的開發與商業化權利，但已提供ConSynance在中國大陸地區開發與商業化該化合物的限制性授權。我們進行預臨牀PoC研究，評估HBS-102對PWS小鼠模型中暴食、體重增加及其他代謝參數的影響。最終報告於2024年第三季收到，
結果與預期結果一致。此外，13週毒理學研究已完成，我們認為初步結果令人鼓舞。

我們正在評估一種新劑型pitolisant，用於治療較大CNS適應症的疲勞。其組織胺能作用機制獨特地針對疲勞的三個不同維度：身體、情緒與認知。我們已產生臨牀數據支持pitolisant用於治療疲勞的效用，包括在DM1的第二期概念驗證研究與用於治療阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症患者殘餘嗜睡的第三期研究。我們計畫評估此新劑型用於更廣泛的適應症，以MS患者的疲勞為主要適應症，並探索其他潛在機會，如中風與帕金森氏症的疲勞。目前我們的重點在於劑型最佳化與新給藥方式，並朝向第一期PK研究。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
WAKIX 以及我們未來開發的任何其他產品候選品之持續商業成功，將取決於其市場接受度程度。
WAKIX 或我們未來開發的任何產品候選品之市場機會，可能小於我們之預估。
第三方關係對我們業務至關重要。若我們無法建立並維持策略性合作關係，或這些關係未能成功，將可能對我們業務造成不利影響。
我們可能需要根據業務需求增加組織規模與能力，並可能面臨管理成長的困難。
我們未來的成功取決於我們保留關鍵高階主管及吸引、保留並激勵合格人員之能力。
我們或我們所依賴之第三方，可能因天然災害而受到不利影響，且我們之業務持續性及災難復原計畫可能無法充分保護我們免於嚴重災難。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，以及本年度報告表10-K所包含或引用的其他資訊，再做投資本公司的決定。若任何上述風險發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果或前景造成重大且不利的影響，進而導致本公司普通股的市場價格下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。本年度報告表10-K亦包含涉及風險與不確定性的展望性陳述。請參閱「第一部分—關於展望性陳述的警示說明」。實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述所預期的有重大且不利的差異，原因包括下列因素，如後述所列。
本公司業務高度依賴唯一核准產品WAKIX的商業成功。若本公司無法維持或增加WAKIX的銷售，將會對本公司產生收入及財務狀況造成不利影響。
歷史來看，本公司業務高度依賴WAKIX，財務結果亦大幅受到WAKIX銷售的影響，WAKIX已核准用於治療成人嗜睡症患者的EDS，於2019年8月核准，並核准用於治療成人嗜睡症患者的癲癇發作，於2020年10月核准。
於2024年6月，美國食品藥物管理局核准WAKIX用於治療六歲以上嗜睡症患者的日間過度嗜睡。於2026年2月，美國食品藥物管理局核准WAKIX用於治療六歲以上嗜睡症患者的癲癇發作。除了本節其他地方所討論的風險外，本公司從WAKIX銷售產生收入的能力，取決於許多因素，包括但不限於：
● 我們銷售與行銷策略及營運的成效，以及獲得WAKIX市場接受度，包括從現有及未來治療選擇中爭取市場佔有率；
● 維持符合所有適用於WAKIX及我們商業活動的規範要求，包括美國食品藥物管理局所要求的上市後要求及上市後承諾；
